faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by the Andhra Pradesh State Co-operative Bank (APCOB) for hiring eligible banking professionals.

faq.question: Q2. What is the post name for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The post name is Chief Business Development Officer (CBDO) on a contractual basis in Andhra Pradesh.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the Chief Business Development Officer (CBDO) position.

faq.question: Q4. What is the mode of application?
faq.answer: The mode of application is offline. Candidates must download the application form and send it by post or email along with required documents.

faq.question: Q5. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The last date for submitting the completed application form is 07 October 2026.

faq.question: Q6. What is the minimum educational qualification required?
faq.answer: Candidates must be a graduate from a recognised University/Institution with desirable qualifications like MBA/PGDM/CAIIB and relevant banking experience.

faq.question: Q7. What is the age limit for applicants?
faq.answer: The minimum age is 40 years and the maximum age is 62 years as on 01.09.2026.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any application fee?
faq.answer: Yes, all candidates are required to pay an application fee of Rs. 1000/- as specified in the official notification.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process?
faq.answer: The selection process includes preliminary screening, submission of a 3-year Business Transformation Strategy, and a personal interview.

faq.question: Q10. Where should the application form be sent?
faq.answer: Applications must be sent to the General Manager (HRMD) at the APCOB head office address in Vijayawada as specified in the notification.
